coverage_gaps.description: No dedicated unit test file for workflow_controller.py agent. Only covered in integration tests.
Unit tests mock prior_agent_outputs but do not test actual data flow between agents in detail. Integration tests cover this but could be more comprehensive.
test_migration_repair_evidence.py has a placeholder test for concurrent writes but doesn't actually test threading/multiprocessing scenarios.
Migration audit agent tests do not test actual SQL parsing of real migration files, only mocked scenarios.
Publisher agent tests mock commit behavior but do not verify actual git operations with real repository.
Static reviewer and verification runner tests do not validate against real database schema, only mocked responses.
Most agent tests verify error handling but do not test recovery mechanisms or retry logic.
No performance or load testing for agent execution time, evidence ledger writes, or database operations.
